BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled amidst the unspoilt beauty of the Mayo countryside, this 1950s bungalow occupies a 
generous site of approximately 1 acre in the highly desirable area of Killawalla, Westport. Surrounded 
by breathtaking natural scenery, rolling landscapes and tranquil rural vistas, the property offers an 
idyllic rural setting while remaining within easy reach of Westport and its many amenities. 
Extending to approximately 796.10 sq. ft. (73.96 sq. m.), the residence is in need of complete 
refurbishment and modernisation throughout. While requiring extensive works, it presents an 
excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking to restore and reimagine a property to their own 
specifications, whether as a family home, holiday retreat, or investment project. 
The accommodation comprises an entrance porch, sitting room with open fireplace, three bedrooms, 
a storage area, kitchen, rear porch, and a shower room. The existing layout provides a solid basis for 
redevelopment, with ample scope for reconfiguration and enhancement, subject to the necessary 
consents. 
Outside, the substantial site enjoys exceptional privacy and stunning views of the surrounding 
countryside, offering ample space for landscaping, gardening, or future enhancement, subject to the 
necessary planning permissions. Adding further character and potential to the holding are the 
remnants of traditional outbuildings located on both sides of the property. To the rear stands the 
ruin of an old cottage, presenting an intriguing opportunity for restoration or alternative use, subject 
to obtaining the necessary planning permission. These additional structures enhance the appeal of 
the property for those seeking a project with scope to create something truly unique. 
The peaceful location combines the serenity of rural living with convenient access to Westport and 
its many amenities. 
The property is expected to qualify for the Derelict Property Refurbishment Grant, subject to the 
purchaser meeting the relevant eligibility criteria and obtaining approval under the scheme. This 
could provide funding of up to €70,000 towards refurbishment works, representing a significant 
contribution to the restoration of the property and further enhancing its appeal. 
Properties of this nature, set on such a generous holding and surrounded by spectacular scenery, 
rarely come to the market. Combining the opportunity to create a distinctive home with the 
potential benefit of substantial grant assistance, together with the added potential offered by the 
existing outbuildings and former cottage, this is a truly exceptional prospect for discerning 
purchasers seeking a rewarding refurbishment project in one of County Mayo's most scenic and 
sought-after locations.
